title: Cleaning an OT-2 COVID-19 Diagnostic Station
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beb5jaq6

steps.title: Wipe parts with bleach
steps.instruction: Using a 1:10 dilution of bleach, wipe the clear polycarbonate windows, black pipette stems (avoid the rest of the pipettes, including the ejectors), the aluminum deck, and the removable black trash bin.

steps.title: Bleach contact time and rinse
steps.instruction: Allow the bleach to sit for 30 seconds, then quickly rinse all surfaces with distilled water to prevent discoloration or corrosion of the aluminum.

steps.title: Wipe parts with RNaseZap
steps.instruction: Wipe the same parts previously cleaned with bleach (clear polycarbonate windows, black pipette stems, aluminum deck, removable black trash bin) using RNaseZap or RNase AWAY, and also wipe the bottoms of the pipette ejectors, any Temperature or Magnetic Modules on the deck, and any 96‑well aluminum blocks that will be used.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the bottoms of the pipette ejectors.
Wipe any Temperature or Magnetic Modules present.
Wipe any 96‑well aluminum blocks to be used.

steps.title: Rinse RNaseZap solution
steps.instruction: Rinse the RNaseZap or RNase AWAY off all surfaces with distilled water.

steps.title: Dry the OT‑2
steps.instruction: Wipe the OT‑2 dry with a clean cloth, or allow the water to evaporate.
